decisive_spans.text: The final histopathology showed granulomatous inflammation with central necrobiosis, extensive Alcian-Blue positive mucin, and scattered multinucleated giant cells

response.rationale: The histopathology findings of granulomatous inflammation with central necrobiosis, extensive Alcian-Blue positive mucin, and scattered multinucleated giant cells are highly specific for Necrobiotic xanthogranuloma. While Idiopathic orbital inflammatory disease also involves granulomatous inflammation and soft-tissue thickening, it lacks the specific histopathological details present in the vignette.
